# Canonical offline providers and ledger attribution

The complete 14-file shared root/providers/callledger source closure is copied
unchanged from royharden/llm-router-eval commit
`2671816d4f4fc46b9a650fc4c05ae4389dada326`, tree
`2887e018acff384fc1a872080f399c2aeb44c5e0`.
`providers-LICENSE.md` here retains the original MIT notice.

The exact source, public schema/test assets and supplied synthetic price fixture
are recorded by path, SHA256 and size in the exact65-member successor
`scripts/provider_distribution.json`.
Every canonical product source file preserves its exact committed Git bytes.
Windows working-file CRLF views from the owner were not copied or relabelled as
committed bytes. The source archive checker requires the fixed capsule and
rejects altered members or substituted policy bytes.

The public test and utility files adapt only the namespace, relocated utility
paths, consumer source path for subprocess imports and one wrapped import line.
All 232 collected scenario identities remain present. Original and adapted source
digests and exact diffs are retained in agent receipts outside the product repo.
The supplied price snapshot remains synthetic and conveys no current pricing,
account access or funding authority. Runtime is Python 3.12, Pydantic 2.14.1 and
stdlib. No SDK, HTTP client, credentials or owner app imports are installed here.

The controlled successor changes only callledger/ledger.py among the fourteen
canonical runtime files. The other thirteen are identical to the original c7a03a8
publication. Six additional purpose cases verify declared per-child purposes,
rejection of a root-purpose impersonation, optional caller-limit omission,
transaction rollback and real controller zero-dispatch behavior. The two public
fixture helpers are unchanged apart from their established consumer namespace.
Original63-member source policy/proofs remain in Git history; the active65-member
policy records the prior digest and exact successor publication. Only ledger.py
and the two new purpose test files change within that protected capsule.

This publication does not include the owner's optional scorer/rubric library,
generation-repair API, SDK/backend, live account, billing or native quality.
